usedFor: Micro keeps deals, contacts and organizations in one workspace, and HubSpot receives them as new contacts or deals.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new deal is created” in Micro, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A deal added in Micro appears in HubSpot as a deal, so the pipeline there matches what you entered.

watchOut: “When a deal is updated” in Micro fires on every update, so “Create Deal” can duplicate the deal.
